description: The frozen split for the detector evaluation. train and dev use the train objects of groundtruth/splits.json, split in time; test is the holdout objects, scored only with --final. Do not edit to change a score.
assignment: 'to' is exclusive. An event belongs to the period holding the midpoint of its window; a detection to the period holding the epoch before its step. Only a period's events and detections are matched with each other.

groups.GEO: QZSS geostationary logs (QZS-3, QZS-6); GEO acceptance rests on these
groups.IGSO: QZSS inclined geosynchronous logs; reported separately
groups.ISS: NASA and Roscosmos ISS lists (lower bounds, not operator logs)
groups.GEO-Fengyun: Fengyun benchmark lines; exploratory, never counted toward a target
